thread_messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-234 — latency spike affecting streaming and short-text endpoints in us-west-2. P95/P99 trending up. Paging on-call.
emma (oncall): oncall here, pulling up dashboards. p95 for streaming route is 320ms -> 1.6s in the last 6m, p99 is 610ms -> 3.1s. Seeing increased tail at workers running quantized models.
raj (infra): noticed node-level CPU steal on some GPU hosts, but main signal looks like long tails on kv cache misses after a precision rollout. Which rollout went live ~00:05 UTC?
maya (runtime): we pushed a precision profile change at 00:03 to enable int8+fp8 hybrid on larger context shards for throughput. Canary looked fine locally but we had limited traffic.
liam (sre): can confirm a spike aligned with that rollout. Streaming clients report stalls (chunks not arriving) at 4–8s. Logs show repeated recompile/soft-fallbacks on model shards:
```
WARN runtime: dequantize-fallback shard=shard-17 model=gptx-large reason="kv mismatch" retries=3
TRACE kernels: selecting fallback kernel for layer 10
```
carter (support): we already have a message thread from AcmeCorp complaining about slow chat replies. They report multi-second stalls on long-context prompts.
emma (oncall): quick customer-impact triage: affecting ~2% of requests but hits enterprise customers using streaming long-context. Severity = P2 -> escalate if not mitigated in 30m.
ops-bot: Automated mitigation candidates: 1) rollback precision profile for production pool, 2) route streaming traffic to dedicated non-quantized pool, 3) increase KV cache size on affected shards. Runbook suggests rollback first.
raj (infra): rolling back precision profile would be fastest. Taking shard-level rollout off-line for 5min to revert. ETA 3m. /deploy rollback --profile=hybrid-int8-fp8 --env=prod
maya (runtime): note: rollback needs coordinated cache warmup. If we revert, expect initial p95 flares while caches refill. Suggest also enabling fallback-routing to higher-tier nodes to avoid customer stalls during warmup.
liam (sre): agree. Start rollback + route 30% of streaming traffic to dedicated "stable-large" pool. Running route change now.
emma (oncall): routing change applied. Observability: p95 down to 780ms within 90s, p99 still ~2.2s. Some shards still showing stall loops.
maya (runtime): investigating the dequantization path. Found a regression in the quant calibration where a metadata flag `kv_ordered_checksum` was mismatching across replicas, causing cache invalidation storms.
liam (sre): can you hotfix that flag checking to be tolerant? If not, keep rollback and routing in place.
maya (runtime): quick patch prepared: add guard to skip strict checksum on mismatch and log metric `kv_checksum_skips`. Patch ready to hotpatch with minimal restart.
raj (infra): prefer not to restart GPUs in prod during rollback. Hotpatch the runtime library where possible. I can push to canary hosts first.
emma (oncall): canary push to 3 hosts now. Monitor p99 and streaming chunk gap metrics.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: hosts [can-21, can-22, can-23].
maya (runtime): canary shows reduction in dequantize-fallback logs and chunk gaps reduced by ~60% on can-21/22. can-23 still noisy, investigating.
liam (sre): while canaries run, let's set an alert to notify if p99 > 2s for more than 3m. Also notify support to give customers a short status note.
carter (support): drafting message: "We're investigating increased latency for streaming responses in us-west-2. Engineers are rolling back a recent precision profile change and routing traffic to stable nodes. Expect improvement within ~10–20 minutes. We'll follow up." OK to send?
emma (oncall): yes send now. Include workaround: restart the client if streaming stalls persist to re-open connection.
carter (support): sent to affected customers list and posted in #general with link to incident tracker.
raj (infra): canary patch looked good for two hosts. I'll promote patch to the rest of the pool with a 30s stagger.
maya (runtime): promoting patch. Also enabling `bypass_kv_ordered` feature flag on affected replicas to reduce invalidation thrash.
emma (oncall): p95 ~260ms, p99 ~900ms after patch promoted to 60% of pool. Streaming chunk gaps down significantly. Customer reports coming in say "much better".
liam (sre): monitoring sustained for 12m. No new dequantize-fallback loops. Recommending keep rollback active until next maintenance window then re-evaluate precision rollout with tighter canary traffic profiles.
maya (runtime): root cause summary: calibration mismatch in the new precision profile (hybrid int8/fp8) produced inconsistent KV checksum metadata across shards under load, triggering repeated dequantize fallbacks and cache thrash -> tail latency + streaming stalls on long-context requests.
emma (oncall): impact summary for postmortem: affected region us-west-2, p95 peaked ~1.6s, p99 peaked ~3.1s, customer-visible stalls for streaming long-context clients, ~2% of total requests, higher risk for enterprise streaming customers.
carter (support): logged affected customers and their SLA windows. No hard SLA breach yet but potential. We'll prioritize follow-ups.
raj (infra): follow-ups: add validation gate to precision rollout pipeline to check kv checksum stability under synthetic load, expand canary traffic to 1% of production for future precision profiles.
maya (runtime): engineering action items: 1) revert hybrid profile until calibration fixes and stronger verification tests exist, 2) add checksum tolerance and better logging, 3) add automated perf regression test for streaming chunk gap under quantized paths.
liam (sre): ops actions: create rollback playbook snippets, automate traffic routing to stable pools during precision rollouts, add p99 early-warning alert for quant transitions.
emma (oncall): handing off to daytime oncall @raj for follow-up and postmortem lead. I'll update incident tracker and mark as mitigated conditionally. If p99 creeps above 1.5s, wake me.
raj (infra): ack. Taking over. Updating INC-2026-234 with timeline and next steps.
ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (traffic routed + runtime patch + profile rollback). Monitoring continues. Will auto-close after 72h with postmortem link.
carter (support): customers notified about mitigation and pending postmortem. We'll follow up with any impacted customers directly.
emma (oncall): thanks team. Good coordination. Closing immediate paging loop but leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
maya (runtime): leaving logs snippet for postmortem:
```
metric: dequant_fallback.count { shard: shard-17 } = 842 (00:03-00:12)
metric: streaming.chunk_gap.ms p99 = 5400 -> 800
```
liam (sre): adding link to runbook changes in the postmortem. Will kick off blameless review tomorrow.
raj (infra): handing off final notes to the next rotation. Verified endpoints stable for 22m.
carter (support): closing customer-facing update thread, keeping one-off support tickets open.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: INC-2026-234 -> mitigated, assigned to raj (infra) for postmortem.
